item.title: Show HN: Fast way to convert any website to agent ready Markdown
item.summary: I have a built a tool called Distill that converts any website to agent ready markdown/structure sub ~16ms. The tool works entirely local. Also did a benchmark on a corpus of 50 urls and Distill outperformed other competitors. Do give it a look: https://github.com/gokulnair2001/distill Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49248306 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
